newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. submarine enters Suez Canal on way to Gulf.
newsitem.headline: U.S. submarine enters Suez Canal on way to Gulf.

text.p: The U.S. submarine Pittsburgh was passing through the Suez Canal on Tuesday en route to joining American forces in the Gulf.

A Reuters television crew saw the nuclear-powered submarine pass by the city of Ismailiya, which lies on the middle of the canal, on Tuesday morning. It was expected to enter the Gulf of Suez later in the day.

The Pittsburgh, which is on its way from the Adriatic to the Gulf, will join the U.S. carrier Enterprise, which passed through the canal on Sunday, and the Carl Vinson carrier for possible military action against Iraq.
Among its arsenal, the Pittsburgh carries Tomahawk cruise missiles similar to those used in an attack against southern Iraq earlier this month.
